title: 5-year-old fatally struck by vehicle in Fort Worth remembered as vibrant, outgoing - NewsBreak
text:
By Timia Cobb Elissa Jorgensen ,
14 hours ago A 5-year-old girl died after she was hit by a vehicle while riding a scooter in the 1900 block of Portland Street in Fort Worth on Sunday, March 29, 2026. The 5-year-old girl who died in Fort Worth on Sunday after being hit by a vehicle while riding her scooter is remembered as having a vibrant, charismatic personality.
Isabella “Bella” Hall died at 9:25 p.m. in the hospital’s intensive care unit, according to the Tarrant County medical examiner’s office. She died after being hit about 3 p.m. in the 1900 block of Portland Street, according to a previous statement from Fort Worth police.
Diamond Hall, Isabella’s older sister, said she was outgoing and lit up any room she entered.
“It’s been very hard to talk about her since she passed,” the 23-year-old told The Dallas Morning News on Wednesday.
Isabella was riding her scooter out of a driveway and into the street when she was hit.
Police said the driver, who was not identified, immediately got out of their vehicle and performed CPR until medical assistance arrived.
Isabella later died of her injuries.
GoFundMe and Meal Train fundraisers were started to help the Hall family with food and funeral costs as they process their loss.
“Bella had an insatiable curiosity, loved learning new things, and brought joy to everyone around her," wrote Jessica Dart, the GoFundMe's organizer. "Her passion for fashion and her radiant smile made every day brighter for those who knew her."
“Her sudden passing has left her loved ones heartbroken and struggling to make sense of a life so full of joy, promise, and love, now cut far too short,” Dart wrote.
